messages:
Maya: brainstorming recruitment criteria for next DP cohort — aim for 10 partners: mix of private/VPC and dedicated-latency use cases.
Liam: split into two tracks: 'Private Onboard' and 'Latency Tuning'. different KPIs, different SE support levels.
Priya: onboarding steps should be <4 items. propose: 1) legal + infra checklist 2) sample integration 3) smoke perf run 4) feedback sync. partners abandon long flows.
Nina: acceptance metrics: for Latency Tuning track require p95 < 200ms on partner traffic sample or clear plan to reach it in 4 weeks. For Private Onboard require successful end-to-end app call in staging.
LegalBot: NDAs + DPA template ok; flag: any HSM/KMS requirements add 3w contracting runway.
Maya: incentives: standardize one offer: $4k credits + 6 SE hours OR 3mo discounted Dedicated pricing. keep consistent to avoid negotiation sludge.
Liam: observability ask: add per-request route tag and trace-id header. ops: need this instrumented before invite.
ops-bot: infra note: canary route + failback to hosted runtime needed. engineering estimate: ~2 sprints to ship per-tenant rollouts.
Priya: feedback cadence: weekly async notes + 30m biweekly review. capture asks in Linear with label 'dp'. set 48h response SLA.
Maya: graduation gates: - perf: target met in 2 consecutive runs - quality: no regressions on partner eval set for 7d - ops: failover tested. also signed minimal contract.
Liam: risks: incompatible infra, feature requests blowing scope, slower contracts. mitigation: fallback to hosted, model variant routing, pre-approved credit pool.
Maya: next steps: Priya will draft invite + intake form; Liam to confirm SE coverage; Nina to produce sample prompt template. Sync Tue 11am.
